::: {#exm-subtree}
#### A subtree of the phone tree

In the phone tree (@exm-phone-tree), the subtree (@def-subtree) rooted at $d$ has the vertices $d$, $g$ and $h$
and the edges $\set{d, g}$ and $\set{g, h}$.
It is the part of @fig-phone below $d$, together with $d$.
The subtree rooted at a leaf, such as $c$, has one vertex and no edges,
and the subtree rooted at $a$ is the whole phone tree.

:::
